data.narrative:
Gallatin AI is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $15M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public frontier-tech firms operating in Defense & Security, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $15M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $38M. Peer-Median analysis references three same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A). The median of these three peers is $400M, establishing a broad range of $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $32M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $219M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty in early-stage defense tech valuations: peer valuations span nearly an order of magnitude, and Gallatin's positioning relative to established competitors remains unvalidated. Key drivers of upside or downside revision would include customer traction, technical differentiation, and regulatory pathway clarity—none of which are quantified in the available data.
